sample_orders.csv.description: Structured order line-item data with customer/product dimensions denormalized for staging.

sample_events.json.description: Semi-structured customer/app events with nested properties.

sample_logs.jsonl.description: JSON-lines application/service logs with INFO/WARN/ERROR levels and latency metadata.

daily_sales_summary_seed.csv.description: Pre-aggregated daily sales trend seed for exploration and forecasting demos.

notes: Data includes weekly seasonality, accelerating growth, promotional spikes, and a brief dip/recovery.
A few intentionally bad records were added for validation/reject-handling demonstrations.
Shared keys such as customer_id and order_id allow cross-source joins.
